title: Settlement of an Approved Claim by Repair, Replacement or Reimbursement under the Northloop Protect Plans
content:
**Settlement rule.** Under the Northloop Protect Plans, an approved claim is repaired unless the estimated repair exceeds the replace threshold rate times the covered item price, or the same failure has already been repaired the lemon repair count of times; then it is replaced with an item of like kind and quality, or reimbursed by Northloop gift card when no replacement is available. One claim never pays more than the covered item price less settlements already paid. A replacement or reimbursement, or settlements reaching the covered item price, fulfil the plan.

On every plan the replace threshold rate is 0.8 (80 per cent) of the covered item price and the lemon repair count is 3.

## Repairs of the same failure

The repairs counted are the plan's completed claim settlements by repair, over the whole life of the plan, whose claim had the same failure type as the new claim. Repairs of a different failure type are not counted.

## Input, judgement and result

| Estimated repair against 80 per cent of the covered item price | Earlier repairs of the same failure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Does not exceed it | Fewer than 3 | Repaired |
| Exceeds it | Any number | Replaced with an item of like kind and quality; reimbursed by Northloop gift card when no replacement is available |
| Does not exceed it | 3 or more | Replaced with an item of like kind and quality; reimbursed by Northloop gift card when no replacement is available |

Whatever the result, one claim never pays more than the covered item price less the settlements already paid on the plan.

## When the plan is fulfilled

The plan moves from active to fulfilled when a claim is settled by replacement or by reimbursement, or when the settlements paid reach the covered item price.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical inputs

Covered item price 500.00 USD, so 80 per cent of it is 400.00 USD.

- Estimated repair 400.00 USD, two earlier repairs of the same failure: the estimate does not exceed 400.00 and fewer than 3 repairs are on record, so the claim is repaired.
- Estimated repair 400.01 USD: the estimate exceeds 400.00, so the item is replaced.
- Estimated repair 120.00 USD, three earlier repairs of the same failure: the same failure has already been repaired 3 times, so the item is replaced.
- Estimated repair 120.00 USD, three earlier repairs all of a different failure type: none of them counts, so the claim is repaired.

**Per-claim ceiling.** Covered item price 800.00 USD with 650.00 USD of settlements already paid: the claim pays at most 800.00 less 650.00, that is 150.00 USD. Should a repair settlement of 150.00 USD be paid, the settlements reach 800.00 USD and the plan is fulfilled.
